title: A unit covector attaining 1 on an orthonormal frame: |β_τ|_E = 1 and β_τ(τ) = 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let τ = (τ_0, …, τ_{n−1}) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P. Then there is an n-covector β on ℝ^P with |β|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm β = 1 and β(τ_0, …, τ_{n−1}) = 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β = 1 ∧ β τ = 1
